name: the @include does not admit /open_edits
why: Tampermonkey would never inject the script on an entity's open edits; the fixture harness injects unconditionally, so only the INCLUDE test can see it.

name: the open-edits pageType never matches
why: Without its match /open_edits gets no button at all (nothing else claims the path).

name: the open-edits pageType does not convert the edit blocks
why: Without editsToTable the div.edit-list blocks stay on the page and no row is built.

name: an entity's /open_edits is not a preview target
why: Without the entity form in _MB_POP_EDITLIST_RE the sidebar's Open edits link gets no card.

name: the open-edits id keeps the link's MBID case
why: An upper-case MBID would key a second cache entry for the same list; the PATH test pins the lowercased id.

name: the open-edits id is named as an editing history
why: Without its _mbEditsLabel() branch the id falls through to the history branch: the card's comment and the window's title are wrong.
